preregistered.estimates: per data circuit, the raw selector contrast P(s=0 | coin read 1) - P(s=0 | coin read 0) with its binomial standard error, and the visibility of the center arm of each scan batch
preregistered.guard: a data batch is admitted when e01 and e10 of each qubit the statistics read (d0, d1, the selector and the coin) change by at most 0.02 between the readout batch before it and the one after; d2 is summed out of both statistics and its qubit's rates are reported unguarded; the decision needs at least one admitted batch of every scan kind, otherwise it reads unresolved_guard
preregistered.control: the inverse-variance mean of the center arm's contrast over the admitted scan batches exceeds 3.0 standard errors; within 3.0 standard errors of zero the offset is absent, below that it is reversed, and either way no mechanism is decided
preregistered.fit: per admitted scan batch, world and noise model, the least chi-square of the batch's three contrasts over the world's one parameter, at the retention or noise strength that reproduces the center arm's visibility through the mean assignment matrix of the two brackets; the noise models are 13 contraction shares (the part of the visibility loss that depolarizes the data bits alone, 0 to 1) and the gate-noise families cz_depolarizing, pulse_dephasing, cz_dephasing, cz_damping, damping_and_dephasing; a world's chi-square is the sum over the admitted scan batches at the one noise model that makes the sum least
preregistered.adequate: a world is adequate when its chi-square is at most the 0.999 quantile of the chi-square law with two degrees of freedom per admitted batch less one for the noise model
preregistered.class: three classes of worlds: a rotation about x added to the pulses (on all pulses, on q8's or on q4's), a rotation about y or z added before or after them (same scopes), and the two selector readout worlds; a class is preferred when its best world is adequate and the best world of each other class sits at least 25.0 above it; the x class is excluded when the two other classes lead, the leader is adequate, the best x world is inadequate and it sits at least 25.0 above the leader; every label is a preference among the modeled worlds and noise models
preregistered.bridge: Rx(pi/2) and X90 read the same selector contrast when both bridge batches are admitted, their within-batch differences of the b0-rx and b0 contrasts agree within 3.0 standard errors of each other, and the pooled difference is within 3.0 standard errors of zero; a class label stands only when the bridge holds, otherwise the series reads unresolved_bridge and reports the class of the Rx circuits. The bridge compares the two gates at zero injected angle and leaves untested that an injected Rx angle acts as a scaled X90 pulse
preregistered.qx: every circuit within twice the sampling floor of its ideal law
